Generated by the lead (tp104). Each sample = sine at its root + a marker partial at harmonic k (−20 dB):
lo(k3) keys 0-59 vel 1-63 · hi(k5) keys 0-59 vel 64-127 · rrA(k7)/rrB(k9) keys 60-127 round robin seq 2 · rel(k11) release trigger, all keys.
Sustain regions loop a whole number of cycles from 0.25 s. 48 kHz 16-bit mono FLAC. "samples" lists files by smp index.
